batch.title: Batch translation

providers.modeDescription: FairTranslator can run provider translation inside the app and apply results directly to the current project without switching tools.
providers.modeFeatures: Context support is provider-specific. Check the selected provider note below before starting a batch.

capabilities.openai: OpenAI uses the app's full contextual orchestration: prompt budgeting, style guide, glossary, protected terms, translation memory, and chunk context.
capabilities.codex: Codex uses the same full contextual orchestration as OpenAI, but executes through the local Codex runtime/CLI.
capabilities.deepl: DeepL runs inside the app and applies results directly, but only receives best-effort glossary and style-guide context. It does not use the full chunk-memory pipeline.
capabilities.google: Google runs inside the app and applies results directly, with glossary plus control-code placeholder protection. It still does not use internal project-memory context.

batch.noProvider: No provider configured. Go to Settings to configure a provider.
